items.prompt: Listen. Hana says: I have two pets, a rabbit called Snowy and a turtle called Max. What is the rabbit called?
hints: Listen to the whole talk first.
Listen for the name that goes with the rabbit.
Say each choice aloud. Pick the one that matches what you heard.

items.prompt: Listen. Guide says: The tour starts at ten forty-five and lasts for an hour. When does the tour finish?
hints: Listen to the whole talk first.
Add one hour to the start time.
Say each choice aloud. Pick the one that matches what you heard.
items.explanation: The right answer is: At eleven forty-five.

items.prompt: Listen. Omar says: I would like to be a doctor because I like helping people. Why does Omar want to be a doctor?
hints: Listen to the whole talk first.
Listen for the word "because".
Say each choice aloud. Pick the one that matches what you heard.
items.explanation: The right answer is: He likes helping people.

items.prompt: Listen. Girl: How much is this notebook? Shop assistant: It is four pounds fifty. Girl: Here is five pounds. How much change does the girl get?
hints: Listen to the whole talk first.
Take four pounds fifty away from five pounds.
Say each choice aloud. Pick the one that matches what you heard.
items.explanation: The right answer is: Fifty pence.

items.prompt: Listen. Tara says: I have been learning the guitar for two years. I play it every day after school. How long has Tara played the guitar?
hints: Listen to the whole talk first.
Listen for how long, not how often.
Say each choice aloud. Pick the one that matches what you heard.
items.explanation: The right answer is: Two years.

items.prompt: Listen. Tom says: I wanted to play outside, but it was raining, so we played a board game instead. What did Tom do?
hints: Listen to the whole talk first.
Listen for the word "instead".
Say each choice aloud. Pick the one that matches what you heard.
items.explanation: The right answer is: He played a board game.

items.prompt: Listen. Mrs Lee says: Everyone must bring a hat and some water to the picnic. Nobody needs to bring food. What must everyone bring?
hints: Listen to the whole talk first.
Listen for "must" and "nobody needs".
Say each choice aloud. Pick the one that matches what you heard.
items.explanation: The right answer is: A hat and some water.

items.prompt: Listen. Sara says: My grandfather is seventy, which is twenty years older than my father. How old is Sara's father?
hints: Listen to the whole talk first.
Take twenty away from seventy.
Say each choice aloud. Pick the one that matches what you heard.
